description: Use when an agent needs the newest token launches on Base. Returns pools created on Base in the last 24 hours on Uniswap V4, V3, V2 and Aerodrome, newest first, with launchpad, liquidity and volume. Each carries its pair, creation time, launchpad named from the V4 hook (Zora, Clanker, Doppler, Flaunch), quote-side liquidity, 24h volume and swaps, and our honeypot simulation for the busiest. Read from Base logs every minute; a snapshot older than 5 minutes answers 503. Costs 0.02 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

min_liq_usd.description: minimum quote-side liquidity (ETH, WETH or USDC held) in USD, default 1000; 0 lists every launch
